variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, pays for the death of Greyjaw, the wolf taking his sheep.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Good day, stranger. I take it you've come about the reward?

I'll pay well for the pelt of Greyjaw, the big grey wolf. Since the thaw he and his hungry pack have been carrying off my sheep.

Mind yourself out in the Ashwood -- those brutes would eat you as soon as look at you.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Is Greyjaw dead yet? I've hardly any sheep left!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Well, well! The howling up in the woods went quiet, so I walked out to have a look.

You've done in that monster Greyjaw all on your own! Amazing! I take my hat off to you! That beast has been at my flock since spring! I'll skin him myself. My sheep can graze in peace now that the wicked brute is gone!

Now here's what I promised -- 100 in gold!

journal.text: Hunt down the wolf Greyjaw for Ulric.

variants.specifics: Khelm: Elka, an ore washer, wants the Giant Leeches that bit her brother Jorrin killed out of the Wash Pools.

offer.speaker: Elka
offer.text:
Somebody help me, please! My poor brother Jorrin was bitten half to death at the Wash Pools east of here! Filthy Giant Leeches crawled up into the basins and got nearly every ore washer in Khelm!

If you kill them off, there's a reward in it for you!

reminder.speaker: Elka
reminder.text: You're still here?! Jorrin gets worse every hour!

completion.speaker: Elka
completion.text: Bless you a thousand times, brave Adventurer! Here, these are for you!

journal.text: Clear the Giant Leeches out of the Wash Pools for Elka.

variants.specifics: Kesh: Dunstav the eel-catcher pays to have the Giant Leech nest in the Sunk Boathouse burned out.

offer.speaker: Dunstav
offer.text:
Curses! Where were you this morning, stranger!? The Giant Leeches swarmed up onto the eel pens, and we'd have lost every pen in Kesh if old Wezzel hadn't flung her salt pots at them just in time!

But in all the fuss, the slimy things crept off into the Sunk Boathouse and laid their eggs there, which makes the lost eels the least of it! The whole hamlet will be crawling with them if that nest is left!

Go down into the Boathouse, west along the lower walkway! Burn out that nest or we're finished!

reminder.speaker: Dunstav
reminder.text: Those leeches are breeding while you stand there! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Dunstav
completion.text:
In better days, all of Kesh would be dancing on the walkways over this! Good work! But Skarn and his Trolls are still out there in the reeds.

Please accept these with the thanks of every eel-catcher in the hamlet!

journal.text: Burn out the Giant Leech nest in the Sunk Boathouse.

variants.specifics: Castle Vorne: Magistrate Quillon has fled his chambers, where wasps have nested, and pays to have them killed.

offer.speaker: Magistrate Quillon
offer.text:
These blasted wasps will be the death of me! My servants swatted at them, but more just fly in! I can only pray that you smoke out the nest and kill every last one!

The nest is in my chambers, up the stairs past the red curtain. Do watch yourself.

reminder.speaker: Magistrate Quillon
reminder.text: I won't set foot in there while those wasps live! Smoke out the nest! Then squash them all! Be quick before it grows any bigger!

completion.speaker: Magistrate Quillon
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my heartfelt gratitude! You have earned a place among the friends of the Keep. I shall tell the gatesmen to let you in and out of Castle Vorne whenever you wish.

Here is your fee, in gold. No, I insist.

journal.text: Destroy the wasps in Magistrate Quillon's chambers.

variants.specifics: Varn: Haskel, head of Varn's fishermen: leeches and bats have taken the Eel Caves and trapped his men.

offer.speaker: Haskel
offer.text:
At last! Something horrible has happened here!

The Eel Caves are crawling with monstrous leeches and shrieking bats out of the black depths. Good fishermen have died down there keeping Varn fed!

I beg you, clear out the vermin and get my men home. I'll pay you well for it!

One of my men locked himself in the first grotto. This key opens it, and he can lead you to the others.

Take this potion against poison too.

reminder.speaker: Haskel
reminder.text: Bring my men back safe and you'll get your pay.

completion.speaker: Haskel
completion.text:
Ha! The caves are clear! You're a real hero!

Take your gold before you go. Oh -- and Odwald came looking for you while you were underground. He's waiting at the boat landing, south of here.

journal.text: Clear the leeches and bats out of the Eel Caves. Free the 4 trapped fishermen.

variants.specifics: Quorra: Grummet, the college gate porter, wants his best hat back from the Imps in the Amber Tower cellars.

offer.speaker: Grummet
offer.text:
Sorry, pal, the front gate's jammed shut! Only other road into the Amber Tower is round the side, down through the cellars where the Imps roost. And if you go that way, watch yourself down there! Them Imps snatched my best hat right off my head while I was dozing in the lodge!

Get it back for me and I'll hand over a cracking good spellbook.

reminder.speaker: Grummet
reminder.text: Got my hat yet? Them Imps won't give it up easy.

completion.speaker: Grummet
completion.text: My hat! I'd given it up for good! I owe you a big one. There's your spellbook, like I promised.

journal.text: Get Grummet's hat back from the Imps in the Amber Tower cellars.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarrow: Ottla, the fort's cook, wants the White Wolves out of her cellar, where her goose Hildy is cornered.

offer.speaker: Ottla
offer.text:
Stranger, please! My poor goose, Hildy, is down in the larder with White Wolves all around her! They dug their way in under the cellar wall!

I'll owe you to the end of my days if you chase them out!

reminder.speaker: Ottla
reminder.text: Hurry, get Hildy out of there! And anything down in that larder, you keep!

completion.speaker: Ottla
completion.text:
She's safe! Bless you, she's safe! Such courage, and how am I ever to pay for it?!

Gold, you say? Lots of it? Well then, if that's your price, here, with my thanks.

journal.text: Save Hildy the Singing Goose from the wolves in Ottla's cellar.

variants.specifics: Vulkir: Dagrun the armorer wants the Beetles of the Beetle Nest gone and her lost ore-carter Pellock found.

offer.speaker: Dagrun
offer.text:
Filthy chewing pests! The Beetles crawled up out of the cinder caves only this month and they're already into everything!

I'm Dagrun the armorer. It's my ore-carter Pellock I'm after. I'm afraid that Beetle Nest has swallowed him up.

Find him for me and I'll see you're well paid. Follow me, I'll point you to that miserable nest beside the slag heaps.

reminder.speaker: Dagrun
reminder.text: Any sign of Pellock? Oh my, I can't bear to think of it.

completion.speaker: Dagrun
completion.text:
Pellock's leather cap! The poor fellow must have met a bad end.

Those Beetles didn't stand a chance against you, that's plain. Maybe you've got the arms for smithing. Hmmm... Could be.

Come by my shop. There's a pair of boots on the bench with your name on it, and some gold too. The guild will have more work for you before long.

journal.text: Learn what happened to Pellock in the Beetle Nest.

variants.specifics: Pellamar: Moggin the goatherd wants the Imp in the well behind his barn killed, the Imp having stirred up the rats.

offer.speaker: Moggin
offer.text:
Good! There's a wicked little Imp nesting in the old well behind our barn, and he's driven the rats wild. Now they bite anyone who comes near my goats -- the sweetest milkers in Pellamar!

Kill the Imp for me. My bow is yours when he's dead.

This iron key opens the barn door.

reminder.speaker: Moggin
reminder.text: It's just one little Imp! Go on and finish him off.

completion.speaker: Moggin
completion.text:
The Imp's dead? Wonderful!

Take my bow, as promised, and show it to Hask at the Lucky Boar. He'll fill a quiver for you. Good luck!

journal.text: Kill the Imp nesting in the well behind Moggin's barn.

variants.specifics: Wendrel: Gaskin the shepherd wants the Ogre that beat his boys and stole his Bow hunted down.

offer.speaker: Gaskin
offer.text: Ohhhh, not again! Both of my shepherd boys lie beaten senseless, and a great hulking Ogre has run off with my Bow! With Mayor Dunstrel's men up at the north gate, nobody else can go. Run him down before he reaches Ketter Hill, quick!

reminder.speaker: Gaskin
reminder.text: That big lout still has my Bow! After him, please!

completion.speaker: Gaskin
completion.text: Ha! My Bow, safe and sound! It's no good without arrows, so have my Quiver as well. Both are yours.

journal.text: Hunt down the Ogre who stole Gaskin's Bow.
